summary: Implemented phases 1-5 of the 11-phase gate-framework refactor, each closed cleanly and committed before the next opened. Phases 1-2 fixed and generalized verify-deploy.sh's unanchored finding-extraction defect (14 call sites). Phase 3 built scripts/measure-gate-costs.sh and captured a clean, fully-idle 23-gate cost table. Phase 4 introduced the declarative gate registry and migrated gates 1-8, confirmed byte-identical output. Phase 5 completed the migration (gates 9-23 wrapped as gateN_run() functions, one shared execution loop replacing all remaining inline blocks), added --max-cost cost-class selection intersecting order-independently with --only-gate, and re-verified all five deploy_findings_snapshot callers green across six existing test suites. Paused at this clean phase boundary rather than opening Phase 6 (uniform bounded timeouts, requiring a deliberately-stalled fixture and a full-battery re-run) given the real-world time already spent on idle-load waits, a full-battery measurement, and the six-suite regression re-run during this dispatch.

artifacts.summary: Partial implementation summary covering phases 1-5 of the gate-framework refactor.
